summary.en-US: Ctrl/Cmd+T and the + button open the new tab in the container of the tab you were on. Optionally pick a fallback container for tabs that had none.

description.en-US:
Firefox opens every new tab outside any container, even when you are working inside one. This extension makes a new blank tab follow you: press Ctrl+T (Cmd+T on Mac) or click the + button, and the tab opens in the container of the tab you were just on. How it works
  • A new blank tab opens in the container of the last tab you looked at in that window.
  • If that tab had no container, the new tab goes to the fallback container you choose in the extension's options. The default is "No container", which leaves the tab alone.
  • Tabs that open with an address (links, other apps, restored sessions) are never touched.
  • Private windows are never touched.
Privacy The extension collects no data and makes no network requests. It only reads which container a tab belongs to. The source code is public: https://github.com/maruen/newtab-follows-container Requires Firefox containers (built into Firefox; the Multi-Account Containers add-on makes them easier to manage).

release_notes.en-US: First public release. Adds an options page to choose the fallback container.
